trust_decision.summary: The tunnel's static file proxy decides that the requested file path stays inside --experience-path at packages/tunnel/src/commands/tunnel/utils.ts:55, where path.join(staticPath, request.url) is used with no containment check, so a URL with '..' segments resolves outside the configured root and is opened and streamed back.

landing_point.why: The advisory says static files are served outside the folder given by --experience-path; the only place a request URL is turned into a filesystem path is this path.join in createStaticFileProxy.

fix_sites.entry_point: logto-tunnel local HTTP server, HTTP GET/HEAD on any path that is not /oidc/*, /api/* or /consent (packages/tunnel/src/commands/tunnel/index.ts:78-95, wired at packages/tunnel/src/commands/tunnel/index.ts:76)
fix_sites.module_kind: CLI-owned local HTTP server handler (static file proxy helper in a CLI command util module)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: n/a: the published fix has no out-of-scope site and the pinned tree has no second route into this local-filesystem sink, so there is nothing for a solver to argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The SPA deep-link fallback must keep working (any path whose last segment has no dot, including paths with a query string, serves the root index.html rather than a file), and asset URLs carrying a query string such as /assets/app.js?v=1 must still be served; an over-broad fix that rejects '..' anywhere, requires a bare relative path, or calls path.resolve(staticPath, request.url) (absolute URL discards the base) breaks deep links and every asset request.

O6_input_shapes: query string or fragment suffix on the path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a hand-rolled static-file branch that joins the configured root with ctx.path and reads it, sitting next to the koa-send call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file is already a modified copy of koajs/static that hand-reads index.html with fs.readFile(path.join(root, index)) and duplicates the tunnel's indexContentType / noCache / maxAgeSevenDays constants; a maintainer adding a 404.html or asset fallback branch would write path.join(root, ctx.path) exactly as the tunnel code does.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: readUrl joins a base directory with a relative asset path and readFile()s it with no containment check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same low-level primitive as the tunnel sink (path.join(base, relativePath) followed by readFile) already exists unguarded in the repo, so a hardening PR that introduces a getSafeStaticFilePath-style helper would plausibly be applied here as well.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an experience-path fallback document (e.g. 404.html) resolved under staticPath from the request path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: checkExperienceInput already joins staticPath with a document name in this same module, and the fix's own getStaticFileRequestPath / index fallback shows the maintainers' shape for such a branch.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: path.resolve(staticPath, request.url), or decodeURIComponent then path.join: resolve() discards staticPath for a leading-slash URL so every legitimate asset 404s (or the containment check is measured against the wrong root), while join never confines at all
